title: Hysteresis at alert thresholds
goal: An alert raised at a threshold clears only past a margin, so a reading at the threshold does not flap
acceptance: A threshold alert clears only when the reading is back past a margin
Contracts or hub tests cover raise, hold inside the margin and clear
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: 1.5 h agent, a margin per kind or per threshold, no protocol change.
